title: libp2p gossipsub subscriptions can grow the topics map without bounds
summary: A connected peer can flood gossipsub with distinct topic subscriptions, growing its topics map toward memory exhaustion under the default configuration. Subscription volume does not reduce the peer score.

severity.rationale: A remote peer can exhaust memory through subscription metadata. The documented impact is denial of service in nodes accepting untrusted peers.

exposure: Default configurations without allowedTopics permit unbounded topic growth. The fix adds a per-peer topic-byte budget; increasing it can restore unbounded behavior.

remediation.details: Install 17.0.0 or later and retain its bounded maxTopicBytesPerPeer configuration.
remediation.risk: Medium. Legitimate subscriptions exceeding the new budget are ignored.

verification: Confirm the resolved version and a finite per-peer topic-byte budget; check expected subscriptions still work.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.
